description: React component for displaying user order data in a dashboard, including fetching data, rendering a table with order details, and handling loading state.

methods.name: TableHeader
methods.description: Renders the table header for the orders table.

methods.name: TableBody
methods.description: Renders a table row for a single order, displaying product info, status, total, contact details, transaction ID, and timestamps.

methods.name: OrdersComponent
methods.description: Main component that fetches user orders and displays them in a table, with loading state handling.

methods.name: UserOrders
methods.description: Wrapper component that includes layout and renders OrdersComponent.
